say:1:1223303001:0.text: What should we do now? Al's still waiting for our goods!
say:1:1223303001:0.source_cn: 这可咋办！阿尔还在等我们的货呢！

say:4:1223303003:1.text: Yes, I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> here! Quick, tell us everything!
say:4:1223303003:1.male: Yes, I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> here! Quick, tell us everything!
say:4:1223303003:1.female: Yes, I brought <style="stress"><player_name></style> here! Quick, tell us everything!

say:5:1223303004:0.text: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
say:5:1223303004:0.male: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
say:5:1223303004:0.female: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...

choice_prompt:6:1223303004.text: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
choice_prompt:6:1223303004.male: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...
choice_prompt:6:1223303004.female: We were robbed. Our goods were taken...

say:7:1223303005:0.text: The robbers were all masked, so I didn't get a clear look at their faces...
say:7:1223303005:0.source_cn: 那群人都蒙着脸，具体什么样没太看清……
say:7:1223303005:0.male: The robbers were all masked, so I didn't get a clear look at their faces...
say:7:1223303005:0.female: The robbers were all masked, so I didn't get a clear look at their faces...

say:8:1223303006:0.text: If I didn't have to mind the goods, I'd have easily taken them all down!
say:8:1223303006:0.source_cn: 要不是我总想护着货，来多少个都给他打趴下！
say:8:1223303006:0.male: If I didn't have to mind the goods, I'd have easily taken them all down!
say:8:1223303006:0.female: If I didn't have to mind the goods, I'd have easily taken them all down!

say:11:1223303007:1.text: Which way did they go? Can we still catch up?

say:12:1223303008:1.text: They're too far away now. *Sigh* It's all my fault!
say:12:1223303008:1.source_cn: 现在也追不上了，唉，都怪我！

say:13:1223303009:1.text: Don't be too hard on yourself! If you can recall any distinctive features of the robbers, you can alert the Carmine Whispers. They'll bring the culprits to justice.
say:13:1223303009:1.source_cn: 别怪自己了，你们再想想那些人有什么特征，回去找血薇帮说...

say:15:1223303010:0.text: That's right! Once we have enough clues, we might have a chance to get your stolen goods back!
say:15:1223303010:0.source_cn: 没错！捋顺出线索，说不定能将那批货追回来！

say:16:1223303011:1.text: To ask for help from those posy parrots? I'd rather—
say:16:1223303011:1.source_cn: 要求助那帮粉毛鹦鹉，那老子宁愿——

say:20:1223303012:0.text: *Cough* <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s helped us a lot. You've got to watch your language in his presence.
say:20:1223303012:0.male: *Cough* <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s helped us a lot. You've got to watch your language in his presence.
say:20:1223303012:0.female: *Cough* <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s helped us a lot. You've got to watch your language in her presence.

say:21:1223303013:1.text: Uh... Anyway, I'll never ask the Carmine Whispers for help!
say:21:1223303013:1.source_cn: 呃……总之，老子绝对不找血薇帮的求助！

say:22:1223303014:1.text: Let's head back and find Al. He must be swamped with the fish stall opening.
say:22:1223303014:1.source_cn: 先回去找阿尔吧，鱼铺要开张，他一个人肯定忙不过来。
